intro.text: The crime lord Sharezan's second-in-command, who kills six trackts in a raid before Ais hunts him down.
Sharezan's second-in-command, a devout warrior-priest arrested by Ais, who carries out Sharezan's orders against her.

items.text: Lokmlen fled a raid in which he had killed trackts, and Ais chased him to Portside Market. He called her a traitor to her people and faith and goaded her until he had her beaten, but Aarik stepped in, dodged his attacks and stamped on his foot, and Ais arrested him.

Tain claimed Lokmlen had broken under questioning, though that may have been a lie. Freed, he rejoined the gang, planted a fire trap at the orphanage where Ais grew up, and was waiting at the hideout where Sharezan sprang his trap on her.

appearance.text: Brown-skinned and bald, with a Kerztian cross scar across his forehead and eyes, a goatee, and a single hoop in his left ear; he is armed with a sword and a zinkall.

personality.text: A devout and outspoken Kerztian of the warrior-priest DaiKeen.
